provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: Every active potential monomial has at least two basic Casimir factors.
provenance.method: Adjoint sl2 branching and the nilcone-slice complete intersection; two exact expansion algorithms
provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal for the scalar Casimir graph presentation. Does not compute full Macdonald, establish physical filtration uniqueness, locate a jump or extend Schur validation.
provenance.stored_macdonald_arithmetic: Stored results of a closed campaign; original verification metadata preserved
provenance.variable_convention: z^2 = t = qT; degrees in the rational function are z degrees

notes: The complete invariant ansatz is P=c M with c nonzero. Every restricted gradient and every jet is multiplied by the same unit c. The Jacobian ideal, its differential closure and the fixed Casimir auxiliary-variable ideal are identical for all nonzero c, including their T filtrations. Thus no coefficient-sensitive rank drop exists within this ansatz; c=0 is excluded.

The QQ minimal second module at (6,1) has total dimension 2 and zero-weight multiplicity 2. Its residual-flavor singlet multiplicity is 2, confirmed by complete character decomposition and the Weyl denominator. A complete resolution independently agrees in the required window. The full slice presentation and original target are retained; index checks are unchanged.

The paper requires the flavor-singlet condition at (6,1), q^7, within P=(xy+z^3)t+a*z*t^2 with the fixed reduced Higgs branch C^2/Z3. Independent QQ calculations give ordinary minimal singlet beta2=2: one universal Koszul class and one further class. Equation (3.6) prints one; this convention difference is unresolved and no universal class is silently subtracted. The previous charged diagnostic is outside the accepted paper verification and is withdrawn.
